theorem lg_target (G : Type u) [Group G] [Finite G] : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimitsOfShape (CategoryTheory.SingleObj G) FintypeCat := by
  constructor
  intro F
  use [F.obj (default G), F.map (id : G → G)]
  intros f g
  use [f, g]
  constructor
  intro h
  exact h
  intro h'
  exact h'
